lines.ff4ad07357bcd452: Think I'd kill my own kin?
lines.268858b3b1e2bc0d: Hmph... I knew they were filth...
lines.00ceef127d5d60d1: Is this how humans do it?
lines.7fb0195ceac09b36: I must face a fool who knows no gap...
lines.1fd4cc6b49e8e6f8: Yes... an ugly dance suits you well
lines.056cf2acd3ed8e14: To think you'd be\nthis foolish, Apollo!
lines.68d604e1e39aa962: Even Mechanical Angel Aquarion\nis no match for Shishi...!
lines.10ba65dd7a2df551: Can you afford to hold back?
lines.147e69c519e83e00: That's all you've got, I see.
lines.e7531b0a8e35b269: Hit all you want.\nYou'll see it's useless
lines.6c660ca02897da65: You're no match for Cherubim Mars!
lines.6122dc3dc7946bfc: You who bear no\nwings... Know your place
lines.1d0421d103f3041b: You still don't get it...\nAll resistance is in vain
lines.e3b506a64fe8d5cc: I am the Wing of the Sun, beast!
lines.9b1520e0f054481b: This is Aquarion's power...?\nI overestimated it...
lines.08d60d9498e8af33: Right... All you have\nis brute strength!
lines.37287cf83dbdbdd8: Not bad...! I'll grant you that much!
lines.9ac4a45a4d690481: How could I... Playing\ntoo much with Wingless!
lines.515b722c9b0f4d78: Guh! How long will you defy us skies!
lines.be01ff67052891dc: You, Apollo...! Always\ngetting in my way!!
lines.7d79333dabdb9326: Silvia... Your hand meant\nto strike your brother!?
lines.bee3da7bcc9af443: For Aquarion without Vector\nMars to do this well...!
lines.d82f7996b01d2519: Unthinkable! That I'm used\nby these useless fools!!
lines.877bb0fe743978cf: Gah! Strength and\nskill Should favor me!!
lines.ab90db2d9b80f6f1: Curse you...! This disgrace,\nI cannot show Lord Zushi!
lines.cdf11fcad6d9c490: Wingless! Where does\nthis power come from!?
lines.e4a3a4bf125c0258: For me to be driven this far!?
lines.239a9ae02cd704a2: Why... me, Wing of the\nSun, pushed this far!?
lines.491ab6c68a1d3961: Grrr...! That tomboy sister of\nmine will get a scolding later!
lines.041eb9e0fca5a7f7: Impossible... Cherubim Mars\noutdoes Aquarion in all ways!
lines.f9557ee2c1723b28: Zambot Cross Slash, did it land!
lines.f61ff25a95f419ff: Finish them off with\nMoon Attack, Kappei!
lines.08e48fb65ed972f2: Yeah! Let's go, big bro Ichi!
lines.10f2ab74188d45a0: You think I'll just back down now?
lines.71cefbfb75c16c45: This time's our show of power!
lines.7e48f2781c81b20e: This won't settle The fire in my gut!
lines.7b2092ca3ede894f: I won't end just taking hits!
lines.d62248111e620d45: I'm pissed off now!\nYou won't get away!
lines.1d4b4256f51b2e23: Hit back when hit,\nthat's how you fight!
lines.8f3cd66a53d43f2e: Banjo! Leave the rest to me!
lines.f855daaac7afbaeb: Banjo's done a lot for me!
lines.6ee2d1afa82ae697: Did I use too much energy?!
lines.07c5649a725f2f23: I'll handle this!\nKappei, cool your head!
lines.fbe05ac7987d2b76: Come out, come out, whatever you are!
lines.b8a1e2ff1881de1b: Damn it! Where the hell did it go!?
lines.6ed51247e69cc521: I'm searching on my side too!
lines.612bdf2712d73a94: If I see it coming, it won't hit!
lines.ef3e35c464200b68: Hey! Stop fooling around and do it!
lines.3994b69b41b88162: Got some tricks of my own!
lines.5c2c5473496a8774: Whoa! Gramps is gonna yell again!
lines.e67f676a0819c78e: Man Kappei Jin won't fall to this!
lines.d92e830f530e7de8: Enemy's gotta be shocked! Heh heh heh
lines.6509b8eb280537a0: Shut up! You watch\nhow the enemy moves!
lines.0f19737096a944c7: Kappei! You're relying too\nmuch on Zambot's power!
lines.3f69eb0d53408978: Heh, I wasn't counting on that!
lines.8797f56bf8ddf2df: What are you saying!\nAvoid useless damage!
lines.5801556386a905c7: What's this, what's this!\nAll bark, Mech Boost!
lines.b0b14a7e91645f5d: Gaizock's attacks are nothing to me!
lines.991f4ef1273def13: Quit your damn griping! I'm\nbusting my ass here too!
lines.7bfa4f2c86294ecf: I know that! ...Man, you're so noisy!
lines.01caabb394bd4c64: You son of a...! I'll\npay you back tenfold!
lines.223975d78ffc2f74: Kappei, calm down! Find their pattern!
lines.163ffb2dfa358b0e: Gah! I'm still raring to go, Butcher!!
lines.9a73131ebd1f47bd: I'm no Zambot who'd Fall to a Gaizock!
lines.ede1e59719c1c80c: Dammit! I won't lose to you!
lines.2fbf16d957b04ad7: At this rate Zambot\nwon't hold, Kappei!
lines.7d01a76a2659ed07: Don't talk crap! We\ncan't back down now!
lines.36d3fb9cb91fe567: If we run, they'll\nattack! We hold here!
lines.b1848ce725e1e2da: Damn it! That hit a bad spot!
lines.0c2ca5cb350af071: Shit! Those Gaizock\nbastards, how dare they!!
lines.870da77d38e075ec: Butcher! I won't lose to you, no way!
lines.c31232dae63ca318: Damn it! Did they get me!?
lines.7183c12c29ac13c3: Leave this to me, I said!
lines.1625b3eb0212521e: Danger! At this rate, I'm finished!!
lines.43bed1120c534b93: Close combat it is...!\nCan you do it, Kappei!?
lines.42ecf9c2299e2f73: Wild swings won't work!\nAim for his weak spot!
lines.d0ca1c427059171f: What are you doing! You'll get nailed!
lines.3dede205448cdd15: Damn! This Mecha Boost is a handful!
lines.31e48e9e65d5fad2: Kappei, at this rate Zambot's\ncircuits will be wrecked!
lines.2145c0e35ac59c5e: The circuits, but...\nI'm done for first...!
lines.88f3fbef7da4d3b1: Ahhh! Please, Kappei's my only hope!
lines.385acf37a6fc0fc2: I've got your back! Let's gooo-!!
lines.2ae9b8d0fad17e41: Heh, that didn't hurt a bit!
lines.dc0cb8e46f74a7cf: Hah, hit me if you can!
lines.691cf69ef42480f9: Hey, Kappei! Treat her with more care!
lines.3297c8060bfc8bb5: No good, Uchuta, Kappei\ncan't hear at all.
lines.7f23fea873ef1817: Keiko, find their weak spot again!
lines.83f51baca8b7d1a2: Graze and this impact...\nBandock, such power...!
lines.2bf675f81c5d9a8a: With Bandock here, I won't give up!
lines.52cd839a8fc875f9: Ahh! S-So this is Bandock's power!?
lines.d80d2e76d4642205: Take me down? No way I'll lose!!
lines.766c6c335f3edfbe: This wound's nothing vs Aki's pain!!
lines.4043bcefd2bf674e: Wait, Aki... I'll\nbeat them for sure...!
lines.7725a833a49f6f9a: I won't lose...! I\nwon't lose to you guys!!
lines.3d2cd33577e3f275: We can do this! We can win!
lines.0efcda37d55d3eb5: You don't intend to talk, do you!?
lines.56f9823a6d1b8bdb: Is that thing really\nrunning on gasoline!?
lines.2013d079c036c587: A demon...! A true white demon!
lines.78cc53100e69dd69: Let me show you what happens!
lines.b3f9a0cd9e207515: How lively... I'll break you first!
lines.6c669bf35ec74948: Can I keep this one, Ryoshi?
lines.18b771025939ca99: I won't lose to a Wingless!
lines.5d7090adce8aaf5f: See! You're no match for me!
lines.0dc9c865077ddb4b: How fun! This is really exciting!
lines.87cd5f89a4af60f1: Hmph, the Wing of the\nSun... is nothing special!
lines.54b148119cb8a529: Huh, what's that? Are you serious?
lines.b3f6eba8dbec289f: No way. I won't let\nWingless break my toys.
lines.d3e91de1d3d5855e: Don't touch me with dirty hands!
lines.20534988131de919: I wasn't planning to play\nwith Wing of the Sun...
lines.5ddf604ea72ef682: What are you doing! Stop it!
lines.220c748ab0823822: You noisy brats! And I\nwas having so much fun!
lines.19403063815113d7: Stay out of my way! You pest!
lines.923897ae45a4cbb1: Tch! You guys really tick me off!
lines.3713353ee5cb10b7: Trying to break my toys!\nI won't forgive that!
lines.3b6b6555d0ff08d7: This isn't the least bit fun at all!!
lines.2c3304fb4ee1e068: What's going on?! It's\nnot moving at all!
lines.fefec7ad4192403e: I'm mad now! I'll get serious!!
lines.a961aa29c2d4b2ef: Enough of you! Don't come near me!
lines.7c6a07b513740d6a: Uwaaaah!! Is this the\npower of the wings?!
lines.54c0ebbe29bb27ca: Don't make me dirty my hands...
lines.3174694158f9a599: Even this small power, gathered,\ncan bring destruction...
lines.8200673a2cf03800: Where are you going!\nThis isn't over yet!
lines.34456d378c823841: Are you ready!? All units, attack!
lines.179df83a5c5dee6b: Getter's mine! You won't take it!
lines.df1f4364e2d63afa: This Mecha Tekkoki can't be beaten...!
lines.abe62e5e8d4b3ec2: I won't let you get away!
lines.6bc49c4a14e59afa: Don't underestimate me,\nTetsuya of this blade!
lines.d873555219baf98f: Leave that guy to me, fall back!
lines.f3445a8fc4dffaa7: If you wanna live, stay out of my way!
lines.d7494a49e3e6ec1c: This Great won't be hit by that!
lines.0b4c6561b57b0b78: Facing Mazinger is just a waste!
lines.9d2138360cffa9eb: Guh! Don't think I'll fall so easily!
lines.104e38f75204007f: If it comes to this...\nI'll fight till death!!
lines.9224d2fe55ff8970: I won't die! Not in\na place like this!!
lines.ab2234cb34934154: Ugh! Great, you can still fight!
lines.715846cb0ff244b2: Nugh! Get up, get up, Great Mazinger!!
lines.54444d6aaed6b2c2: This kind of pinch, I'll\ncut through with Mazinger!
lines.f6581cb9838b3a13: Others might fall,\nbut not me with that!
lines.d009901583fade0c: Pain like this is nothing\ncompared to that training!
lines.39f50da614bc9d89: Damage like this...\nGreat can handle it!
lines.95342e50ec5fc315: Hmph... You're worthy of\nfighting Great Mazinger!
lines.659e4e9163621589: So you can fight on\npar with Mazinger, huh!
lines.68883a02e221db02: Next time, come at me with\neverything you've got!
lines.1911b7d80a72fa85: What's wrong? Is that all\nyou've got to fight my Great?
lines.9166fe27405a58bd: No way!? Great being taken down...
lines.1c66e49fbf711c54: Gah! N-no good... Is\nthe damage too much!?
lines.78e60d9e00c180c9: Damn it! Great taking\nthis much damage!
lines.979eb8f8d7a212b4: Ugh! Mazinger won't be taken\ndown by something like this!
lines.67210d0ab0abb3cc: Damn! Fine!! But I'm just starting!
lines.28a02d5ac742df5c: Not yet! I won't go down!
lines.23dcbcae190261c0: An attack like that won't faze me!
lines.dde31dfb00d0bf88: Do you think that can work\non this Chogokin New Z body!
lines.0957eb0f0b538b13: This ends it! Final Dynamic Special!
lines.1798ff14c7615714: Daisuke, I'll take it from here!
lines.b9bf5457ad97088d: Duke Freed! Kouji! Let's finish this!
lines.562daab2b61ee024: Yeah! Let's show them our power!
lines.0d0aff525a714e9a: This is Tetsuya! Launch\nthe Great Booster!
lines.0428247e8f754425: Mizuki, don't let the enemy escape!
lines.a00ba0bdd8dbf866: Touga! Here we go with the Sword!
lines.c8fc4942dcaadeab: Runa! Use the Graviton Tornado Punch!
lines.9ebc7b79eb7d30fd: Enemy units are in our range!
lines.bb049f26da9cfc8b: Touga! Sol Graviton Crusher Punch, go!
lines.e39778bd1a5a344a: Eiji! Use the Sol Graviton Cannon!
lines.ea0ac63f64c64f27: Ooh! Take this! Sol Graviton Cannon!
lines.e8c0b363e3fed319: Out of my way! Sol Graviton Cannon!
lines.3a1f1163c5159fab: Runa! Sol Graviton Bringer, stand by!
lines.83152b81c5eedfe5: I won't just smash you to pieces!
lines.1798a920496465fa: Touga! We'll go with\nSPIRAL CRUSHER PUNCH!
lines.45360ffd97a8847d: Runa! Eina! Sol Gravitons Pai\nLal Crusher Punch, standby!
lines.a3678580550c73fe: Leave it! I'll smash him up!
lines.4c2fc47a5f67073a: Touga! Eiji! Let loose one big one!
lines.58688cf46e8ddcb7: We'll be the Red Fangs\nthat burn the dark age!
lines.93f33b9633c8107b: Sol Gravion! Light to\nearth! Justice to evil!
lines.e024038c1fb087b2: Here I go! Ultra Heavy Sword!!
lines.90dba6ca1f7d98af: We'll be picked off like this, Touga!
lines.483d6517e4f26bbc: Zeravire! Don't think\nyou know our power!
lines.26476c8c47f37675: Sol Gravion is not just power!
lines.bf029246ed3bfcd2: You won't hit me that easy!
lines.a70049044b43de9d: Heh! That's only natural for us!
lines.f0b5372c5571ad22: Yeah! Let's keep this up, Touga!
lines.0e79a987a80289dd: No one can sink the sun!
lines.12556cc915cd690e: I won't let you! No more!
lines.5b1ad946d58ffab6: Tch! Not time for sunset yet...!
lines.486e68767665a20f: Don't think you can\nput out the sun's fire!
lines.812a8fb5bce0a7c5: Don't give up, Leele!\nWe're still alive!
lines.fb56d4aadfe6acbd: Not yet! I still have power left!
lines.2aeb26324837d759: I will never give up!\nUntil all is settled!
lines.136d2e8af1d1939c: I've got your back! Hold on, Touga!
lines.38b54ac085ef1f2f: Tch! Not a fatal wound, but...!
lines.f57922bba66f7793: Not yet! Gravion can still fight!
lines.9ed5e1d34c2310f8: Damn! I can't break\nmy promise to Sandman!
lines.2c8de4f0a12d459b: We won't fall till mission's done!
lines.b3f5143d674e2f5b: Come, Zeravire! We can still fight!
lines.5224c26305bd128e: Damn! You're not half bad, enemy!
lines.510368cd811db449: If you think sun's\nfuel out, think again!
lines.0c3d1eba595a1618: It's your lives that'll run out!
lines.9099aac90c06d38a: Lay a hand on Enou and\nI'll show you guts!
lines.a6d79b656f0fc988: You want to fight Sol\nGravion that badly?!
lines.d38bf343d3401db8: Then I'll fight you, as asked!
lines.bed5c11b2810fd48: Copy looks, but not the guts!
lines.adc153dda2eb17d8: Think I'd fall for that line?
lines.0c16f9001ed202f0: We're not called Sol\nfor nothing! Sol!!
lines.ead551b7628da489: Armor dented, but I can go!
lines.4c91117d5913187e: Heh! As expected of Sol Gravion!
lines.3ba491ea4f926b71: No wonder Sol Gravion! Built tough!
lines.cbe04c72750b1cb2: Gaizock...! I cannot\nallow you to exist!
lines.6f9cc3c6a0f0f84b: If I hold back, we're doomed!
lines.337c2b9ae5eea89f: Sandman! Faye! Lend us your power!
lines.19f4385009d5fd09: All Grandeevas, launch a wave attack!
lines.378ed3a7461d79ce: Right and left drill\ncockpits, deploy boosters!
lines.9504098aad16b2f4: Right and left drill cockpits,\nboosters at full output!
lines.8b664fe73f0ab34c: All units, fire! Sweep the enemy!
lines.3262d9b374f2c52c: Leave it to me! Graviton Rifle!
lines.c568d8b3462a0435: Left Driller cockpit, Graviton\nTornado Punch, standby!
lines.8c9bb9c99e0dcd56: Left Driller cockpit! Use\nGraviton Tornado Punch!
lines.e03ad1f737281ae8: Ha! Keep me company a bit more!
lines.0357ebc7ad32bbdd: That all you got?! Train more!
lines.862323814b8f6a77: No, you won't escape.\nI'll finish you here!
lines.bc94d3d5b0a94d1b: You kept up with my moves...!
lines.ced57976407fbba0: Looks like there's no\ndamage to the surroundings.
lines.2fd7904991d81736: G Shadow cockpit, focus\nforward, not around.
lines.afe829a1bc94a879: That power... I can't\nlet my guard down.
lines.fd4b292c08a5bdd7: It's sluggish...! Did they\nhit the drive system...?
lines.014349c37629f05c: Log Zeravire hit.\nKeep watch after this.
lines.5130506994fdc8de: Stop it before it evolves further...!
lines.3803f6643a952d2b: This is all or nothing! Charge, Touga!
lines.53fa0865a1a4bcef: I can't agree to that plan
lines.fff923b3f122502a: Damn! Zeravire has power like this!
lines.bf19e9d6a920c209: Left Driller cockpit, Graviton\nPressure Punch, standby!
lines.fe113afe2e169e48: Lady Leele, please don't overdo it.
lines.6ed93ef0d052e80d: Just like Lady Mizuki! So dedicated!
lines.6faab4dc78d4fc23: Eep eep eep! I'm out of energy--!
lines.2e98f61d2e41d861: Enemy attack missed by a lot!
lines.ee81d22a1aa49fe4: Eina, don't let this scare you!
lines.19c2f515ae775a9f: What?! What is it about\nyour glasses, Eina?!
lines.6342bad20990eda8: The Zeravire's power...\nis below our estimates!
lines.782fa29a4fd9e3fb: Then let's finish them off now!
lines.4d547f3eaffb80a3: Calm down, Eina! We're not done yet!
lines.41142df269a5e992: Enemy squadron... is\nfocusing fire on Gravion!
lines.4268e779c8c5890f: Not your fault, Eina.\nDon't worry about it.
lines.84b1a4ef0be61aff: Armor load is over the limit!
lines.418600005d6b6723: Hell! One more hit and I'm done for...
lines.945750556a3f4600: N-no! The controls are full of errors!
lines.b27732e71157d2df: Z-Zeravire is closing in even more!
lines.34b26b09cb966029: They won't just let us pass
lines.f5932e7ef61668a0: That guy! I'll smash him to bits!
lines.7562bbb823438306: That worry can wait!\nLet's get out of here!
lines.35797d8bf5f8b32c: Just as I thought... I\ncan't protect anyone...!
lines.48b183027daa1110: Attacking me was your doom's start...
lines.fbc891795ae1f4c2: I feel your heart. Let's settle this!
lines.93c3d00c0faccf7f: Come, let me bury your hopeless love.
lines.bcf86a855061c90d: You did it... care to die here...?
lines.c12ea2e4a6244797: Fruit at its peak... Just like prey.
lines.2ba61fa345da76fa: Onshi... I leave the rest to you.
lines.154d6bba0077e1ca: Lord Ryoshi, I'll\nhandle the Wingless ones
lines.975d09c4fc2bb683: Shishi... At last, by your side...
lines.db48865bae6e00ea: Savor it all. Take it in.
lines.2cfa9590da410cd5: 12,000 years too early to hit me!
lines.e34a389693b2788a: Don't touch me with those wings!
lines.cce1f131e9d734a7: Only trust what you\nsee. Wingless attacks...
lines.ab9e519dbcd669d5: An attack from a Wingless? Ha!
lines.8d2b77cc9c00635a: Did you think that would work, filth?!
lines.6f5d1086ca52c695: I can't comprehend\nsuch a pointless act...
lines.059e5b842e058171: Is that all...? Then let\nme bury your hopeless love
lines.9608df96cd87178a: That's bad... Not knowing\nyour own limits...
lines.72fe3f61201e6ff9: How sad... that former\nfoes have become so weak...
lines.e4f306306ee3413d: I see... your power is clear!
lines.9c83ccde38518006: ...Interesting...! Looks like\nyou'll amuse me a little...!
lines.c94cf68ace896c2e: Not bad... I may need\nto revise my view...!
lines.388e4d2d924cd2fe: Hmm... you seem capable of\nproducing better prana...!
lines.658a2cbcfc5f35f4: You charge my Cherubim\nSoldiers... how foolish!
lines.223c988df2a0262f: I must admit... Your will is strong!
lines.110520e7ac8d68c7: Hah... far from the light I loved...
lines.0da01b512074bf9b: What's wrong...? You can still\nshine, can't you, my wings...?
lines.d0ab2d4f8bf0453d: Is my power insufficient...?\nAm I inferior...!
lines.fa248876f9533d73: Gah! ...Fine, the outcome\nis not yet decided...!
lines.290c838af4aa3ce5: Yes, wings... Show me that\nworld-destroying power!
lines.6b0f608132e1f0c0: I won't rest till this\nis settled, Toshiya!
lines.7351d07e5ef513fd: Can't back down from a fight!
lines.c1f91d5b06f13b8b: Thanks to you, my Io\nspirit is on fire!
lines.3dd9b61f947e71a0: Hold on! God Sigma coming through!!
lines.b913419d21f4ac1c: Next is me. Give it up!
lines.e5c5c48a1b9bd61d: Get back! I'll show you Io-style!
lines.5f0dcdce7530fbfb: Double God Sigma power, Take this!
lines.ed1b8a6f30e6824b: A chance! We go as planned!
lines.a6a362cb8e02413e: Damn! Are we to just sit idle...?
lines.e494274efbdd2336: Hey hey! What are you lookin' at?!
lines.925cd58cd44132e3: Whoa whoa whoa! That was close!
lines.96c6b378932ff70c: Heh, don't underestimate\nthese skills of mine!
lines.cbb29717a4492cd1: Heh, piloting robots is\nmy number one specialty!
lines.a42f2ec372b9f61f: Heh, don't worry. Just watch me!
lines.7a4a4b9fcf0df80c: Heh, Eldar attacks? Won't hit me!
lines.2edcc5d2136e9c57: Gagan! I won't let you have your way!
lines.f760c8ae9babc7d1: Heh, this is an easy win!
lines.c2cb857df4c48c1d: A weak shot won't do a thing!
lines.db72028e85af2b9a: Still, it's us who\nget stuck repairing!
lines.06a9379b6003d9a5: Being popular with Elders? No thanks!
lines.c41cc0bbc8813c8e: We're not the type\nto buckle from this!
lines.3ee549a4d2f6b245: Damn it! I won't let him have his way!
lines.a4d5b5ec253a6a94: Don't rush in! Use your head!
lines.82fb7ff2e9cd0acb: Brute force like that\njust raises damage!
lines.5ea5cdaf6dd0b965: No time to be impressed, Toshiya!
lines.26d1fcfb23ecc446: Ugh...! For Io's\nfriends, I can't lose!
lines.eb77afed025bab4c: Just like Teral...! Tough to handle!
lines.c5d1ad2344d02d10: That Gagan's clawing for a way out!
